wiki.title: Devin LeMahieu
wiki.extract: Devin LeMahieu (born August 8, 1972) is an American businessman and Republican politician from Sheboygan County, Wisconsin. He is the current majority leader of the Wisconsin Senate, since 2021, and has represented Wisconsin's 9th Senate district since 2015. He previously served nine years on the Sheboygan County board of supervisors. His father, Daniel LeMahieu, served 12 years in the Wisconsin State Assembly.
